+    def test_get_allowed_origins_legacy_invalid(self):
+        key = "Unattended-Upgrade::Allowed-Origins"
+        self.addCleanup(
+            self._restore_allowed_origins,
+            apt_pkg.config.value_list(key),
+        )
+        for entry in ("invalid", "Ubuntu:lucid:extra",
+                      "Ubuntu lucid extra"):
+            with self.subTest(entry=entry):
+                apt_pkg.config.clear(key)
+                apt_pkg.config.set(key + "::", entry)
+
+                with self.assertRaises(
+                        unattended_upgrade.InvalidAllowedOriginsError
+                ) as caught:
+                    unattended_upgrade.get_allowed_origins_legacy()
+
+                self.assertIn(key, str(caught.exception))
+                self.assertIn(repr(entry), str(caught.exception))
+
+    def test_run_invalid_allowed_origins(self):
+        key = "Unattended-Upgrade::Allowed-Origins"
+        self.addCleanup(
+            self._restore_allowed_origins,
+            apt_pkg.config.value_list(key),
+        )
+        apt_pkg.config.clear(key)
+        apt_pkg.config.set(key + "::", "invalid")
+        dev_key = "Unattended-Upgrade::DevRelease"
+        if apt_pkg.config.exists(dev_key):
+            self.addCleanup(
+                apt_pkg.config.set, dev_key, apt_pkg.config.find(dev_key))
+        else:
+            self.addCleanup(apt_pkg.config.clear, dev_key)
+        apt_pkg.config.set(dev_key, "true")
+
+        with patch.object(unattended_upgrade, "is_update_day",
+                          return_value=True), \
+                patch.object(unattended_upgrade, "should_stop",
+                             return_value=False), \
+                patch.object(apt_pkg, "pkgsystem_lock"), \
+                patch.object(unattended_upgrade, "is_dpkg_journal_dirty",
+                             return_value=False):
+            result = unattended_upgrade.run(
+                unattended_upgrade.Options(),
+                self.tempdir,
+                None,
+                os.path.join(self.tempdir, "dpkg.log"),
+                datetime.datetime.now(),
+            )
+
+        self.assertFalse(result.success)
+        self.assertIn(key, result.result_str)
+        self.assertIn("'invalid'", result.result_str)
+        self.assertFalse(result.update_stamp)
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
